overview.text: x402watch presents behavioral classification of x402 buyers using timing, service concentration, payment amounts, coordinated starts and address patterns. Its Wash Report says updated daily but carries a 2 October 2026 stamp, so its measurements are not current to the recorded visit. Eight labels distinguish organic users, self-tests, developers, suspected wash, agents, analytics bots, exchange users and verifiers; its real-volume filter excludes self-test, suspected-wash and developer traffic. These are operator classifications, not independently established identities or intent. Anonymized clusters can include legitimate production bots.
